The '''Smoking Forest''' was an area on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[Magma|lava]] [[planet]] [[Mustafar]]. One of the planet's few constant features, the region was named for the [[tree]]-like, smoke-belching rock chimneys there.<ref name="BMF17" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Smoking Forest was first mentioned in the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 17|seventeenth issue]] of [[De Agostini]]'s ''[[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon]]'' magazine,<ref name="BMF17" /> published around [[April 29]], [[2015]].<ref name="BMFdates">{{BuildFalconDates|17}}</ref> The [[Smoking Forest/Legends|forest]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it appeared in the [[2005]] [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']] expansion to the [[2003]] [[Sony]] Online Entertainment [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], [[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan]]''</ref>
